title: Frukt Cyder Cherry & Blood Orange 100ml E-liquid
description: The mouth-watering combination of succulent, tangy Cherry and bright, zesty Orange makes this exquisite e-liquid from Frukt Cyder a must-have for a summer’s day – or any day for that matter. Light and refreshing, with a fresh, bubbly cider tang on the exhale, the blend of sweet cherry and rich blood orange make this e-liquid absolutely irresistible. This convenient 100ml nicotine-free shortfill bottle comes with 20ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your liking. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered sub-ohm tanks and mods
